proposals.rule: You can extend at any time before your current permission to stay in the UK expires.
proposals.exception: If you become engaged before extending your visa, do not apply to extend your visa as a fiancé, fiancée or proposed civil partner.
proposals.why: The exception applies only when the applicant is engaged before extending, changing the outcome for that specific situation.

proposals.rule: You can apply to live in the UK to care for your child.
proposals.exception: If you’re eligible to apply as a partner, you must do that instead of applying as a parent.
proposals.why: The partner eligibility case overrides the parent route, narrowing the applicability of the parent rule to those not eligible as partners.

proposals.rule: You can stay in the UK for 2 years and 9 months on this visa.
proposals.exception: If your family member is British, Irish or settled in the UK your stay is unlimited.
proposals.why: The exception applies when the applicant is joining a British, Irish or settled relative, giving unlimited stay instead of the 2 years 9 months limit.
